verdict_rationale: Crowding cluster composite fails graduation on the AUTHORITATIVE lockbox window (<=2023-12-22): rank_IC 0.0157, ICIR 0.118, Harvey_t 0.40, monotonicity -0.65 (inverted). Full-sample (contaminated) numbers were more favorable (0.0209/0.158/1.62) — re-ran with lockbox per init window isolation. Top-20 long-only realized active return NEGATIVE (portfolio_alpha_t=-1.36, DSR_active=0.033). Composite is -32% WORSE than best single proxy CR08 (ICIR 0.118 vs 0.173) = static-blend dilution. recent36_ICIR 0.80 = 6.8x lockbox ICIR (severe recent-period concentration). No realized crisis hedge (crisis_alpha_bad=-0.0052; bad-month deciles flat ~-7%). Liquidity is fine (median ADV 5.2e9 KRW, 1.4% <2e8) so the failure is genuine signal absence, not microcap artifact. AX-005 echo + Cycle 2 lesson (rank-IC t positive but portfolio-alpha t negative). Per failure_rules (mono<0.5) = STOP.
primary_finding: ORTHOGONALITY GOAL MET but ALPHA ABSENT. cor vs STR_1715 = -0.020 (Pearson) / -0.035 (rank); cor vs D track = +0.163 (Pearson) / +0.058 (rank). Both far below the <0.30 target. The crowding cluster IS structurally orthogonal to the book, but it carries no usable long-only alpha or crisis hedge in the KOSPI200_KOSDAQ150 universe, so it cannot serve as a 4th sleeve as-is.
